column1: # hi   = Romanized Hindi, never an English word: always converted
# amb  = Romanized Hindi that is also English ("main", "to"): converted only inside all-Latin Hindi sentences
# name = Indian names and places: always converted (English rules mangle them)
# names: brands and companies (Devanagari respelling of how Indians say them; see docs/voice-system.md).
# WhatsApp is deliberately NOT here: the English route read better on both voices (Whisper-small CER 0.156 vs 0.21-0.33 custom).
